answer: Violet and umber avatars are cheap to forge, so count scarce endorsements instead of profiles. Fixed, vetted seeds each supply one unit of voting capacity. Validators compute one global flow through signed endorsements; a unit used for a vote cannot be forwarded or counted again. A thousand colluding aliases cannot exceed the capacity entering their group. More influence requires seeds to divert more of their fixed budgets to that group. Corrupt seeds can still allocate their capacity to attackers.
